[[File:GeoBeastLarvae-SWTOR.png|thumb|A larva form of [[Geo Beast]]]]
A '''larva''' was a stage of life in the development of certain [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]] had a larval stage. Indeed, dianoga spread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] when their larvae were carried away by visiting [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''.</ref>
